name: Bank07ServiceJumpTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=07 at A000
description: 33 absolute JMP entry points in R7 bank 07; callee gameplay semantics mostly unresolved.

name: Bank08ServiceJumpTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=08 at A000
description: Six absolute JMP entry points in R7 bank 08.

name: Bank09ServiceJumpTable
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Seven absolute JMP entry points in R7 bank 09; A009 reaches front-end sequence A499.

name: FrontEndSequence
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Initialize display and animation, wait on split index 67, then poll two-choice input; preserve outcome carry across cleanup.

name: FrontEndObjectXPair
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Two X bytes 1C/E4 copied to 051B/051C by A4B9.

name: InitializeFrontEndLayout
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Map R6=05, far-call bank07 A0BD, set tile transfer arguments, PPU split fields and IRQ source FA59.

name: FrontEndTilePair
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Two bytes 21/00 used as a PPU transfer source at A585..A599.

name: PollFrontEndChoice
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: A/Start return carry set; otherwise Select/Left/Right toggle 2C, draw cursor and return carry clear.

name: DrawFrontEndCursor
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Write one four-byte OAM sprite at index 99; choose X through 2C; increment 99.

name: FrontEndCursorXPair
mapping_condition: MMC3 PRG mode 0; R7=09 at A000
description: Two cursor X bytes 38/88 for selections 00/01.

name: FixedServiceJumpTable
description: 42 absolute JMP service entries; this identifies destinations, not all destination semantics.

name: ApuInitialize
description: Initialize APU registers and call two five-entry index initializers.

name: InitializeAudioIndicesA
description: Fill 0015..0019 with 05,0B,11,17,1D; audio role from A01 caller.

name: BootFrontEndLoop
description: Map bank 09 at A000, initialize audio and call front end; carry clear loops via A00C.

name: SelectInitialRoute
description: Clear 00/2D; nonzero 2C calls bank 07 A0D8 and chooses resume path using 43.

name: InitializeRunContext
description: Mask 2C to five-bit index 9A and 2D to two-bit 030C; save SP at 016F and invoke initialization.

name: PrepareMainLoop
description: Restore saved SP; initialize PPU shadows, IRQ source F83D, loop flags and per-index audio byte.

name: FourPhaseMainLoop
description: Four D90C-synchronized phases; phase-specific call order and two D9CB mixer calls per cycle.

name: RunControlGate
description: Tail jump to CE/D3/Start control gate D39F.

name: CallBank08FrameGroup
description: Map 03B9 through R6 and 08 through R7; call A006,A000 then tail A009; later targets need callee bank-preservation contract.

name: TailBank09Frame
description: Map R7=09 and tail jump to A000.

name: CallBank07EvenGroup
description: Map R6 from 03B9 and R7=07; call A078,A07E then tail A0B1.

name: CallBank07OddGroup
description: Map R6 from 03B9 and R7=07; call A07B then tail A0B1.

name: CallBank0CAndFixedGroup
description: Call bank-0C trampoline D6D2, fixed D805, then tail D6F0; gameplay meanings unresolved.

name: FinalizeFrameGroup
description: Service palette effect, map R6=06/R7=08, call A00C, then tail E2E2 scroll adjustment.

name: RestartThroughIndexTable
description: Entry D178 pushes zero; D17A can accept one from CE route; remap 9A with D25F, initialize, restore block and choose D21C/D225.

name: ContinueThroughIndexTable
description: Remap 9A through D27F, reset fields, restore saved eleven-byte block, then jump D21C.

name: AdvanceThroughIndexTable
description: Load next index from D23F; FF invokes bank-09 A012 and increments 030C unless equal 03; restart at index 00.

name: ReenterSceneClearFlag
description: Clear bit 20 of F8, call EEA7 and reenter CFE2, or fall through to restore path at D225.

name: RestoreTripletAndReenter
description: Index FDE0 with D3&07; copy byte to 06B9/06BA/06BB; jump CFE2. Gameplay meaning is not assigned here.

name: NextSceneIndexTable
description: 32-byte successor table; index 1B contains FF end-of-cycle marker.

name: RestartSceneIndexTable
description: 32-byte table used by D178 and D363; physical-stage correspondence unresolved.

name: ContinueSceneIndexTable
description: 32-byte table used by D19A; physical-stage correspondence unresolved.

name: ResetRunFields
description: Reset selected fields; if 030E is zero set it to 03 and initialize 0306..030B; set digit-like buffers and call F65F.

name: SaveElevenByteBlock
description: Copy 06C2..06CC to 06CD..06D7, high index first.

name: RestoreElevenByteBlock
description: Copy 06CD..06D7 to 06C2..06CC, high index first; fall through D396.

name: TailBank07Restore
description: Map R7=07 and tail A0C9.

name: CheckRunControl
description: Negative CE decrements 030E and selects D17A/D487; otherwise negative D3 blocks Start, and pressed Start enters D3C4.

name: StartOverlayFlow
description: Save palette and CHR 47/48; invoke bank-07 overlay entries; restore palette/CHR, discard return word and jump D046.

name: OverlayPalette16
description: 16 palette bytes copied to 0133..0142 and 0153..0162 during Start overlay.

name: InitializeCounterZeroMenu
description: Initialize PPU layout, retained-field displays and two-choice selection after 030E reaches zero.

name: CounterZeroMenuLoop
description: Wait/poll; A/B/Start confirm, Up/Down/Select change 2C, draw cursor and repeat.

name: CounterZeroMenuConfirm
description: Choice 00 jumps D19A; nonzero restores block and ED80 then JMP through RESET vector.

name: CounterZeroCursorPointers
description: Two little-endian cursor pointers selected with 2C*2; pointed data not interpreted.

name: ResetRetentionCheck
description: Check retained 0100 marker 68; otherwise load six bytes at 0300; call D2F7.

name: ResetRetainedDefaults
description: Six default bytes copied to 0300..0305; purpose unresolved.

name: HideAllSprites
description: Write F1 to every OAM Y byte in page 02.

name: HideSpritesFromIndex
description: For index 99 below 64, fill remaining OAM Y bytes with F3.

name: MapperWriteRetry
description: Write X to 8000 and A to 8001; retry if interrupt activity changes A6.

name: Bank0CEntry0
description: Map PRG0C at 8000, then tail-jump to 8000.

name: Bank0CEntry3
description: Map PRG0C at 8000, then tail-jump to 8003.

name: Bank0CEntry6
description: Map PRG0C at 8000, then tail-jump to 8006.

name: WaitNmiAndServiceAudio
description: Save X/Y, evolve 97 while 95 is nonzero, set 95=1; temporarily map 00/01 for C7C7 then restore bank tags.

name: UpdateControllerState
description: Shift held-button history; poll twice and AND; compute rising edges, shift A history, restore caller X/Y from stack.

name: ReadControllerSerial
description: Strobe 4016 high then low; read eight times, accept either low data bit, shift into 1F and return it in A.

name: MixTimingStateWithX
description: 97 <- ((((X+97) mod 256) XOR AA)+BD) mod 256; preserves X/Y.

name: ServicePaletteEffect
description: Restore palette when 06EE=FF; decrement 03D5 and choose fixed palette colors using D9 bit 10.

name: AdjustScrollOnOddEffect
description: If 03D6 is odd add 04 to 58; add 10 again when the wrapped first sum is at least F0.

name: ResetEntry
description: Initialize hardware, bank mapping, selected RAM, PPU shadow and palette; jump to PRG0E CF50.

name: NmiEntry
description: Save A/X/Y, OAM DMA, PPU task, scrolling, optional IRQ setup, CHR writes, epoch increment and RTI.

name: DispatchPpuTask
description: Clear A0 using Y; select one of sixteen little-endian pointers with old A0 & 1E.

name: PpuTaskPointers
description: 16 little-endian pointers; indices are command&1E divided by 2.

name: PpuUpload27ViaStack
description: Stream 27 bytes from 0101..011B using PLA, restore SP; increment PPU by 32.

name: PpuTaskReturn
description: Shared RTS target; also fallthrough from A16.

name: UploadPalette32ViaStack
description: Read 0143..0162 through PLA; write 32 bytes to PPU; restore SP and service 06EE flag.

name: DisableRendering
description: Clear PPUMASK and shadows 5F/66; clear bit 1 of 4A.

name: FarCallViaA000
description: Save bank tags and registers, map 04EC into A000, call pointer 04EA, restore both PRG windows and result registers/flags.

name: FarCallIndirect
description: Indirect JMP through RAM 04EA/04EB; called with JSR to make the callee return to wrapper.

name: WaitCountedUpdates
description: Call D90C and decrement X until zero; initial X=00 means 256 updates.

name: WaitCountedOrAStart
description: Counted wait with early exit on newly pressed A or Start; returns masked input in A.

name: WaitForAStart
description: Repeat D90C until newly pressed A or Start.

name: EnterInitialRunContext
description: Tail jump to fixed CFA2.

name: IrqEntry
description: Save A/X/Y in E2..E4; acknowledge/disable IRQ, enable again, dispatch through E5/E6.

name: IrqSplitPpuAddress
description: Timed PPU address/scroll writes indexed by 67; choose terminal split at F0 sentinel; share IRQ return.

name: IrqSplitScroll
description: Timed indexed scroll/control writes; select F83D on F0 sentinel.

name: IrqRestoreRegisters
description: Increment A6, restore Y/X/A from E4/E3/E2, RTI.

name: IrqSplitSwitchChr01
description: Timed split setting control, mask, address and CHR registers 0/1 to 0/2; set next IRQ low pointer 82.

name: InterruptVectors
description: Little-endian NMI, RESET and IRQ/BRK vectors in the fixed final bank.

name: ButtonsPressed
description: Newly pressed A/B/Select/Start/Up/Down/Left/Right bits; scratch during serial poll.

name: ButtonsHeld
description: Held input after AND of two polls; temporarily stores first sample.

name: AButtonHistory
description: Shift register of held A over eight completed input updates.

name: MenuChoiceOrInitialScene
description: Front-end/counter-zero menu choice; later masked to initialize 9A. State-dependent scratch.

name: InitialCycleScratch
description: Masked with 03 into 030C; cleared on front-end return and high-cycle path.

name: InitialRouteFlag
description: Checked after initial nonzero-2C path; gameplay meaning unresolved.

name: ChrBankRegisters
description: MMC3 R0..R5 shadow values; each byte is a bank number

name: PpuCtrlShadowBase
description: First PPUCTRL shadow; indexed usage has unresolved array bounds

name: ScrollXShadowBase
description: First horizontal scroll shadow; indexed bounds unresolved

name: ScrollYShadowBase
description: First vertical scroll shadow; indexed bounds unresolved

name: PpuMaskShadowBase
description: First PPUMASK shadow; indexed bounds unresolved

name: SplitPpuMaskShadow
description: Mask used by terminal split handler

name: IrqSplitIndex
description: Index advanced by IRQ split handlers

name: NmiSplitSelector
description: Selects NMI scroll/control indexing path

name: SplitControlIndexBase
description: Index source; table extent unresolved

name: IrqLatchBase
description: First IRQ count/latch byte; indexed bounds unresolved

name: FrameNmiHandshake
description: D90C waits for zero then increments to one; NMI F116 writes CHR-loop X (zero under documented 96=0/1).

name: NmiIrqSetupFlag
description: Controls NMI IRQ setup; tested values 0 and 1 only

name: FrameTimingMixerState
description: Mutated in NMI wait loop and by X-dependent mixer; RNG consumer relationships unresolved.

name: OamUsedSpriteIndex
description: Index used to hide remaining sprites; valid count below 64

name: SceneIndex
description: Indexes 32-entry next/restart/continue and other setup tables; stage-name mapping unresolved.

name: PpuUploadAddress
description: Little-endian upload destination used by 27-byte stack transfer

name: NmiPpuTaskCommand
description: Command masked with 1E for pointer-table index; consumed by NMI

name: RunUpdateFlags
description: Written 41 during setup, 00 during overlay and 01 on return; full bit semantics unresolved.

name: MapperInterruptEpoch
description: Incremented by NMI/IRQ; cleared and compared by mapper writer

name: RunTerminalStatus
description: Bit 7 selects counter-decrement/restart path in control gate; producer not traced.

name: RunControlAndTripletIndex
description: Bit 7 blocks Start overlay; low three bits index FDE0 on restore; progression meaning not assigned here.

name: IrqHandlerSource
description: Little-endian source copied to E5/E6 during NMI IRQ setup

name: IrqSavedA
description: IRQ A save slot

name: IrqSavedX
description: IRQ X save slot

name: IrqSavedY
description: IRQ Y save slot

name: SharedDispatchPointer
description: Shared little-endian PPU-task/IRQ target; lifetime-dependent meaning

name: NmiSavedA
description: NMI A save slot

name: NmiSavedX
description: NMI X save slot

name: NmiSavedY
description: NMI Y save slot

name: ResetRetainedMarker
description: Value 68 suppresses retained default copy; not cleared by RESET

name: PpuUpload27Buffer
description: 27 bytes streamed using temporary SP=00; page is also CPU stack

name: PaletteUploadBuffer
description: 32 bytes streamed using temporary SP=42; page is also CPU stack

name: RunEntryStackPointer
description: Saved before run setup and restored at CFE8 to abandon intermediate call frames.

name: TransferSavedStackPointer
description: Real SP saved during PPU stack-based transfers

name: OamDmaBuffer
description: CPU-side OAM buffer; one sprite per four bytes, Y at multiples of 4

name: ResetRetainedBlock
description: Not cleared on reset; first six bytes defaulted when 0100 differs from 68; purpose unresolved

name: ProgressionCycleIndex
description: Initialized from 2D&03; incremented on FF route unless already 03; semantic difficulty effects unresolved.

name: RemainingAttemptsCandidate
description: Set to 03 if zero during reset; decremented on negative CE; zero selects two-choice menu. Lives interpretation awaits producer/gameplay validation.

name: FrameBank8000
description: Bank number mapped through R6 by frame wrappers; producer not yet traced.

name: PaletteEffectCountdown
description: Nonzero value is decremented in E2A3 and may select color 30 with D9 bit 10.

name: ScrollEffectPhase
description: Odd values trigger four-pixel scroll adjustment; cleared on loop setup and overlay return.

name: FarCallTarget
description: Little-endian target CPU address

name: FarCallTargetBankA000
description: MMC3 R7 bank value for far call

name: FarCallSavedBankA000
description: Bank identity read from BFFF

name: FarCallSavedBank8000
description: Bank identity read from 9FFF

name: LiveSavedBlock
description: Eleven bytes copied to 06CD..06D7 by D37F; field meanings unresolved.

name: SavedRunBlock
description: Saved copy of 06C2..06CC; restored during restart/continue.

name: PaletteUploadPostFlag
description: If initially nonzero, palette upload replaces with FF; wider meaning unresolved

name: PreviousButtonsHeld
description: Previous completed input state; seeded FF on boot front-end entry.

name: SecondPreviousButtonsHeld
description: Older completed input state copied from 0713 before polling.
